Refutation evidence

  • Counterexample: Refutation of Lemma · paper.tex, lines 6 to 11. This evidence addresses the statement itself.

    Take X_{n,j} independent Bernoulli(1/n) and m_n = n^2: each fixed j has P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) = 1/n -> 0 when 0 < eps < 1, and zero when eps >= 1; also m_n -> infinity. Thus both hypotheses hold, whereas P(max_{1<=j<=m_n} |X_{n,j}| > 1/2) = 1 - (1 - 1/n)^{n^2} -> 1. Hence the stated conclusion itself fails, not merely the written argument.

Independent review

Manuscript label: lem:growing-max.

Initial challenger verdict: Incorrect. Reconciled verdict: Incorrect.

Initial assessment of this conclusion: written argument: Invalid; statement: Refuted; recorded verdict: Incorrect.

The proposed obligation preserves the source distinction between each fixed jj and the growing maximum. On a one-point probability space, take mn=nm_n=n and Xn,j=1{j=n}X_{n,j}=\mathbf{1}_{\{j=n\}} for 1≤j≤n1\le j\le n. For every fixed jj, Xn,j=0X_{n,j}=0 for every n>jn>j, so the hypotheses hold. Yet max1≤j≤n|Xn,j|=1\max_{1\le j\le n}|X_{n,j}|=1 for every nn, giving P(max1≤j≤n|Xn,j|>1/2)=1P(\max_{1\le j\le n}|X_{n,j}|>1/2)=1. Thus line 16 does not follow from line 15, and the counterexample refutes C001 itself.

Refutation evidence

  • Counterexample: Refutation of Theorem · paper.tex, lines 20 to 24. This evidence addresses the statement itself.

    On a one-point probability space take m_n=n and X_{n,j}=1{j=n} for 1<=j<=n. For each fixed j, X_{n,j}=0 whenever n>j, hence convergence in probability holds; m_n tends to infinity. The stated estimator definition gives hat{theta}_n-theta_0=max_j |X_{n,j}|=1 for every n. Thus P(|hat{theta}_n-theta_0|>1/2)=1 for every n, directly contradicting the exact theorem conclusion.

Manuscript label: thm:main.

Initial challenger verdict: Incorrect. Reconciled verdict: Incorrect.

Initial assessment of this conclusion: written argument: Invalid; statement: Refuted; recorded verdict: Incorrect.

The inherited hypotheses in the normalized obligation agree with the locked lemma statement, and the estimator definition agrees with line 22. They do not establish the lemma conclusion invoked in lines 27-28. On a one-point probability space, let mn=nm_n=n and Xn,j=1{j=n}X_{n,j}=\mathbf{1}_{\{j=n\}} for 1≤j≤n1\le j\le n. Every fixed coordinate is eventually zero, but the maximum equals 11, so θ^n=θ0+1\hat\theta_n=\theta_0+1 and P(|θ^n−θ0|>1/2)=1P(|\hat\theta_n-\theta_0|>1/2)=1 for every nn. The substitution in line 29 would be valid if the maximum converged, but the invoked prerequisite is false under the inherited hypotheses. This invalidates the written proof as a proof of the stated theorem and refutes C001.

Why the step fails

Take X_{n,j} independent Bernoulli(1/n) and m_n = n^2: each fixed j has P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) = 1/n -> 0 when 0 < eps < 1, and zero when eps >= 1; also m_n -> infinity. Thus both hypotheses hold, whereas P(max_{1<=j<=m_n} |X_{n,j}| > 1/2) = 1 - (1 - 1/n)^{n^2} -> 1.

Option 1: Strengthen assumption

Add the hypothesis sup_{1<=j<=m_n} P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) <= a_n(eps) with m_n a_n(eps) -> 0 for every eps > 0, and derive line 16 from the union bound under it.

Recorded repair search

  • union_bound: Bound P(max_{j<=m_n} |X_{n,j}| > eps) by m_n * sup_j P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) using only the stated per-fixed-j hypothesis. Outcome: Failed. The hypothesis fixes no rate: sup_j P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) may decay arbitrarily slowly, so m_n times it need not vanish; the Bernoulli(1/n) array with m_n = n^2 realizes exactly this failure.
  • subsequence_argument: Extract along subsequences of n to recover the maximum's convergence from per-fixed-j convergence. Outcome: Failed. Along every subsequence the same growing union appears; the counterexample tail 1 - (1 - 1/n)^{n^2} tends to one along every subsequence.
  • strengthened_hypothesis_variant: Add a uniform tail bound sup_j P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) <= a_n(eps) with m_n * a_n(eps) -> 0 for every eps > 0, then close the growing union with the union bound. Outcome: Survives local inspection. Under the added uniform rate, P(max > eps) <= m_n * a_n(eps) -> 0 closes S004/M001 locally for every eps; the full affected-closure recheck remains required.

Search conclusion: Candidate repair exists. This records the bounded search, not impossibility of other repairs.

Evidence still required: A revised statement or hypothesis set under which the growing-maximum step is provable. Full rechecks of lem:growing-max, thm:main, the D001 dependency use, and both required challenges.
